tagline: Offline Torah Notes & Hebrew Handwriting OCR Studio
taglineHebrew: סטודיו אופליין לזיהוי ועריכת כתב יד תורני ומחברות שיעורים
releaseTitle: v1.4.0 — Major OCR, Security, Organization & UX Suite (Perspective Flatten, 2-Page Split, Lasso Scan, Find & Replace, .ksav Projects, SHA-256 & Fast Delta Patches)
description: Ohr HaKsav (אור הכתב) v1.4.0 is a major release adding CamScanner-style 4-point perspective flattening, open two-page notebook splitting (Hebrew RTL order), shadow & ruled-line cleaning, 180° upside-down check, lasso region OCR for margin notes, low-confidence line highlighting (F8), High-Accuracy Beam Search mode, inline Find & Replace across entire notebooks, drag-to-reorder pages, saved .ksav notebook projects, visual proofreading confirmation before learning, two-column Sefer Word export, SHA-256 update verification, Strict Air-Gap zero-network mode, Privacy Wipe, and lightweight delta patch updates.
features: Perspective Dewarping ('CamScanner' 4-Point Flatten): Automatically flattens angled or trapezoidal phone photographs of notebook pages before OCR for cleaner line segmentation.

Open Two-Page Notebook Split (Hebrew RTL Order): Detects the vertical center crease of open-notebook spreads and splits them cleanly into Right Page -> Left Page (plus a one-click '📖 Split 2-Pg' button).
Shadow Removal & Pale Blue Ruled-Line Suppression: Toggleable image cleaning flattens desk-lamp shadows and fades light blue notebook lines while keeping pen and pencil strokes crisp.
180° Upside-Down Orientation Check: Automatically tests line confidence upright vs. flipped 180° when confidence is low and corrects upside-down photos automatically.
Lasso '✂ Scan Region' Tool (Ctrl+R): Draw a box around any margin note (hagahah) or stubborn paragraph on the page image to OCR just that selection and insert it at your cursor.
Low-Confidence Line Highlighting & F8 Quick-Jump: Lines with < 75% OCR confidence are softly highlighted in amber; click '⚠ uncertain (F8)' or press F8 to jump directly to lines needing proofreading.
Fast vs. High-Accuracy Mode (Beam Search): Toggle between Fast Greedy decoding and High-Accuracy Beam Search in the Scan menu without restarting.
Inline Find & Replace (Ctrl+F / Ctrl+H): Search and replace Hebrew words on the active page or across EVERY page in the notebook in one click.
Page Reordering (Drag-and-Drop + ▲/▼ Buttons): Easily reorder out-of-sequence phone photos in the sidebar before exporting to Word.
Saved Notebook Projects (.ksav): Save and reopen named multi-page projects (Ctrl+Alt+S / Ctrl+Shift+O) preserving page order, rotations, OCR scans, and proofreading edits across weeks.

Visual Proofreading Learning Guardrail: Clicking 'Save & Learn Mistakes' (Ctrl+L) opens a clean confirmation checklist of extracted mistake -> fix pairs so you never accidentally train a sentence rewrite.

Unified Word Export & Two-Column Sefer / Kuntres Layout: Choose Standard Pages, Continuous Flow, or Traditional Two-Column Sefer layout plus Hebrew fonts (David, FrankRuehl, Miriam) in one clean dialog.
Lightweight Delta Patch Updates (~90% Smaller): Future code/UI updates download a small delta patch zip instead of re-downloading the entire 468 MB AI runtime.
SHA-256 Update Integrity Verification & Code Signing Support: Every installer and patch is cryptographically verified via SHA-256 before execution, with built-in Authenticode signing support.
Strict Air-Gap / Zero-Network Policy (TAG & Filter Safe): New settings checkbox & OHR_HAKSAV_OFFLINE_ONLY=1 policy completely disables all outbound network probes.
Automatic pdf_cache Cleanup & Shared-PC Privacy Wipe: Automatically purges temporary PDF page PNGs when clearing a session, plus File > Privacy Wipe for shared Yeshiva lab computers.
